subject: Rate-tier restructure and change order execution
messages:
From: DevOps Lead <devops@novusai.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: restructure rate tiers for Q4 capacity

Hi Karthik / Monica —

We ran a Q4 capacity forecast and want to move a portion of our committed capacity into a usage-tiered tranche for the last 3 months of the year. The goal is to avoid overcommit spend while still preserving burst capacity for our production models.

Can you outline the simplest path to do this as a change order? Key asks:
- Move 30% of the committed GPUs from fixed monthly commitment to a variable rate-tier for Oct–Dec 2026
- Adjust the effective date to Oct 1, 2026 and retain existing SLA
- Keep price-per-token within +/- 10% of current rate; we can accept a modest uplift if it preserves burst windows

We'd like to get legal review turned around within 5 business days to meet procurement timelines. Attaching our internal PO that would need to match the order form.

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
Head of Infrastructure, NovusAI

Attachment: novus-po-20261003.pdf (application/pdf)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@novusai.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Contracts Team <contracts@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: restructure rate tiers for Q4 capacity

Alice —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can support a temporary tranche that converts a portion of the commitment to a usage-tiered billable bucket. To move quickly I propose:

1) We prepare a single-page change order (attached draft-change-order-nd-1147.docx) that:
   - lists the units being moved (30% of committed GPUs; equivalent throughput X tokens/day)
   - sets Oct 1–Dec 31, 2026 as the tranche window
   - defines the variable rate tier with a capped uplift (no more than 10–12% over your current per-token rate)

2) SOW note: no changes to delivery milestones; we will preserve the same SLA and support tiers. If legal requires a temporary amendment to the indemnity or data processing section we will handle that in the MSA redline and aim to keep changes scoped to the change order.

3) Timeline: I need signoff from Sales Ops and Legal. Monica — can you confirm the commercial uplift we can offer (target +8%) and whether finance will accept the PO form Alice sent? Jonas — can Legal prioritize a brief redline review and flag any non-starter language?

I'll attach the draft change order to this thread for transparency. If we can get legal comments by EOD Tuesday (10/05) we can route to DocuSign mid-week.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-change-order-nd-1147.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alice Monroe <alice@novusai.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Contracts Team <contracts@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: restructure rate tiers for Q4 capacity

Thanks Karthik — I've reviewed the commercial side. We can do an +8% uplift on the usage-tiered tranche and allow Oct–Dec window, provided finance gets a PO that matches the final order form dollar amount (invoice-first month will reconcile).

Notes for the draft:
- Add a short table that maps committed units -> variable tranche units (helps finance reconciliation)
- Call out a cap on monthly peak bursts (so we don't expose unlimited burst to the variable bucket)
- Include a line item for prorated credits if Novus exercises an early termination for the tranche window

I'll hand off the PO to finance once Legal confirms the MSA redline scope.

-Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Request: restructure rate tiers for Q4 capacity — legal redlines attached

Team / Alice —

Attaching a short redline summary and the MSA excerpt where Legal requests a single-sentence clarification. High level:
- We are comfortable with a time-bound change order that alters billing treatment only; we do NOT want to change the core indemnity, DPA, or uptime SLA in the MSA.
- Suggest replacing the "effective date" statement in the change order with an explicit "billing effective date" to avoid downstream PO mismatch during revenue recognition.
- There's a requested clarification on liability caps for the variable tranche; proposed sentence is in the PDF.

If Novus Legal can accept the minimal language change in the attached redlines-for-msa.pdf we can incorporate it directly into the change order and push to DocuSign. Otherwise we'll need a brief call to resolve.

For execution: if we get acceptance by EOD Monday (10/05) I will issue the final redline and route a DocuSign envelope to the signatories. I also included a checklist for Sales Ops to validate PO-matching and revenue code tagging.

-Jonas
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines-for-msa.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate the quick turn.

Alice Monroe
